The bank lowered its price target to $50 from $57 (~14% upside based on Sept. 16 close).

Boston Scientific has been negatively impacted this year "by a more mature U.S. [pulsed field ablation] market with increased competition, a stagnating [left atrial appendage closure] market, Urology hiccups, and a cybersecurity attack," according to analyst Joanne Wuensch.
She has revised her estimates down eight times year to date.

"BSX has been a steady beat-and-raise stock, and while we are confident that it will work through this, the time to resolution is opaque, investor patience has run thin, and we don’t have a handle on the recovery path."

Wuensch noted that new, proposed guidelines from the Heart Rhythm Society could negatively impact sales of its key Watchman LAAC device. She projects Watchman sales will decline 7.6% in the second half of the year, followed by an 8.8% drop in 2027.
